pages.text: Connection blockers are handy little runes that prevent you from being noticed. Create one by influencing paper with a golden carrot, a fermented spider eye, and power from any source. The more power you feed the diagram, the more durable the connection blocker will be.

While you hold the connection blocker, hostile mobs will ignore you unless you harm them. Each time such notice is evaded, the page will twitch and lose durability.$(br2)But be warned: when you are no longer holding it, the deferred connections will rebound, and all hostile mobs in a wide area will target you for the same amount of time you were holding the blocker.
